display.purpose: Hero H1 and every page H1 (PageHeader); the largest voice on the site.

headline.purpose: Home band openers (SectionHeading headline variant) and the design-detail H1.

title.purpose: Section H2s and card titles; cards scale it to 1.25rem (index) and 1.125rem (design cards).

body.purpose: Descriptions, paragraphs, nav items; secondary body text in Ash.

label.purpose: Footer links, cookie-banner copy, captions, counts (tabular numerals).

eyebrow.purpose: Uppercase letter-spaced Ember label above display headings; hero and section openers only.

shadows.name: structural-card
shadows.purpose: Baseline shadow (Tailwind shadow-md): cards and the fixed header. Constant, never reactive.

shadows.name: framed-artwork
shadows.purpose: Tailwind shadow-xl: the framed artwork card only — the one element allowed to lift like a gallery piece.

shadows.name: overlay-bar
shadows.purpose: Tailwind shadow-lg: the cookie banner and the mobile buy bar — the only floating elements.

motion.name: color-shift
motion.purpose: Default interactive transition (transition-colors): hovers, fills, underlines. Never shadow or transform.

motion.name: card-zoom
motion.purpose: The single sanctioned transform: design-card media zoom inside the clipped tile on hover.

motion.name: buybar-fade
motion.purpose: Mobile buy bar enters/exits by opacity only.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses every transition and animation, including the card zoom.

components.name: Button Primary
components.description: The one loud action on a surface: hero CTA, search submit, form submits, pagination, cookie consent, full-width buy CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; white-space: nowrap; gap: 8px; background: hsl(var(--accent)); color: hsl(var(--accent-foreground)); border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 24px; font: 500 1rem/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(var(--accent) / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring)); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Button Outline
components.description: The quiet commerce and card action ("View design →", "Buy on TeePublic ↗"): Panel surface, Ember label, color-only hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; white-space: nowrap; gap: 8px; background: hsl(var(--card)); color: hsl(var(--accent)); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 500 1rem/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: hsl(var(--accent)); background: hsl(var(--muted)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring)); }

components.name: Accent Link
components.description: The accent text link for internal routes (AccentLink): Ember, underline on hover, 2px ember focus ring.
components.css: .ds-link-accent { color: hsl(var(--accent)); text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-link-accent:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-link-accent:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring)); border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Interest Chip
components.description: LinkChip — the interest chip into the catalog: 44px touch target, Seam border, count in Ash tabular numerals.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; color: hsl(var(--accent)); font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-chip:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring)); } .ds-chip-count { margin-left: 4px; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Design Card
components.description: The catalog card: portrait media tile over the baked background, Poppins title, Ash caption/description, outline action anchored to the bottom.
components.html:
Retro New York City Sunset

Cities

A warm vintage skyline…
components.css: .ds-design-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; background: hsl(var(--card)); color: hsl(var(--card-foreground)); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-design-card-media { padding: 16px 16px 0; } .ds-design-card-tile { position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 10px; background: hsl(var(--muted)); } .ds-design-card-media:hover .ds-design-card-tile { transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-design-card-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex-grow: 1; padding: 16px; } .ds-design-card-title { font-family: Poppins, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.375; margin-bottom: 4px; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-design-card-caption { font-size: 0.75rem; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); } .ds-design-card-desc { margin: 8px 0 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); } .ds-design-card-action { margin-top: auto; align-self: flex-start; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Panel field with Seam stroke, Ember caret, 2px ember focus ring; the select shares the treatment.
components.html: <input class='ds-input' type='text' placeholder='Try cat lover gift' />
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; width: 100%; background: hsl(var(--card)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: hsl(var(--accent)); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring)); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Icon Link
components.description: IconLink — 24px social/share glyph: Ash at rest, Ember on hover on the field, sr-only label, color-only hover.
components.css: .ds-icon-link { display: inline-flex; border-radius: 8px; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-icon-link:hover { color: hsl(var(--accent)); } .ds-icon-link:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring)); }

components.name: Framed Artwork Card
components.description: The signature surface: a Panel gallery frame holding the design's baked-background tile, closed by a hairline rule and an Ash caption.
components.html: Latest print — woven stories
components.css: .ds-art-card { width: 100%; max-width: 448px; margin: 0 auto; background: hsl(var(--card)); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-art-card-tile { position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: hsl(var(--muted)); } .ds-art-card-caption { margin-top: 12px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); text-align: center; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.43; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); }

components.name: Index Card
components.description: The collections/gifts directory card: three artwork thumbs over the panel skin, whole card is one link; border hovers to Ember.
components.html: ProgrammingCode humour for developers…26 designs
components.css: .ds-index-card { display: block; height: 100%; background: hsl(var(--card)); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-index-card:hover { border-color: hsl(var(--accent)); } .ds-index-card:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring)); } .ds-index-card-thumbs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-index-card-thumbs > div { aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; border-radius: 10px; background: hsl(var(--muted)); } .ds-index-card-title { display: block; font-family: Poppins, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-index-card-desc { display: block; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); } .ds-index-card-meta { display: block; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); }

narrative.northStar: Ember on Graphite — the catalog's own artwork glowing on woven graphite.
narrative.overview:
The world is a near-black graphite field in three tonal bands (field Graphite, alt band Slate Band, deepest band Coal Deep), framed above by a fixed Basalt header and below by a Coal Deep footer. Panels sit one tonal step above the field behind 1px hairline seams; nothing is white. One saturated pumpkin-ember orange does all the interactive work — eyebrows, links, focus rings, the primary button — and two signature textures give the dark its depth: faint concentric thread rings plus a single soft ember glow on the hero and philosophy bands (the .texture-weave utility), and a large-offset structural shadow under the framed artwork card. The hero puts the catalog's own product on the first screen: the latest synced design, framed like a gallery piece beside oversized display type with one ember accent word.

The system is a default theme, not a brand. Design Studio is a white-label product: every deployment replaces name, palette, type, and copy through configuration — the home.* studio rows drive the hero copy, philosophy band, and about teaser; the brand mark renders the configured siteLogo or falls back to a monogram tile derived from the configured name's first letter. Token authority lives in the :root custom properties in app/globals.css (HSL triplets, Tailwind convention), consumed through the Tailwind theme mapping in tailwind.config.ts; per-deployment theming rides on config/config.json (or the studio table) and the allow-listed themeLink stylesheet hook. Anything visual that cannot be changed from that layer is a defect.

The token layer is complete: every var the Tailwind mapping consumes is defined in :root, and components consume token classes (bg-primary, text-accent, border-input, ring-ring). Literal colors survive only in sanctioned places: the token definition file, the semantic green/red form-status pair, the light image-blur shimmer, the browser-chrome themeColor meta value, and the satori social-card renderers that must mirror the palette as literals. Browser chrome carries the world: color-scheme: dark, an ember-tinted text selection, an ember caret, and thin token-sourced scrollbars are part of the shipped global CSS. Fonts load through next/font/google (Inter as --font-sans, Poppins 600/700 as --font-display).
keyCharacteristics: Three graphite bands with hairline seams; panels one tonal step up, never white
One ember hue means interactive — links, buttons, rings, eyebrows, chips
Poppins display voice over an Inter body; hierarchy by face, size, and weight
Woven-thread texture bands and the framed artwork card are the signature surfaces
Hover and focus are color shifts only; focus is a 2px ember ring
Fully token-driven and theme-swappable; zero hardcoded brand assumptions

rules.name: The No-Hardcode Rule
rules.body: Colors enter components only through the token layer (:root custom properties consumed via the Tailwind theme mapping). Literal color values are legal in exactly four places: the token definition file, the semantic green/red form-status pair, the light blur-shimmer + themeColor chrome values, and satori renderers that must mirror the token block as literals because they cannot read CSS variables. Nothing else may carry a literal color.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember is the only hue that means "interactive." Links, buttons, focus rings, chips, and active states all draw from it; it should stay under ~10% of any screen's pixels. If everything glows orange, nothing is clickable.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Dark surfaces separate by tonal step plus a 1px Seam border — never by white cards, never by thick strokes. A panel and its field must differ by exactly one step.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Poppins sings only in headings and card titles (font-display); Inter speaks all body copy, controls, and labels. No third family unless a deployment's theme config introduces one.

rules.name: The Color-Only Hover Rule
rules.body: Hover and focus change color, fill, or underline — never shadow. The single sanctioned transform is the design-card image zoom: hovering a card scales its media to 140% inside the clipped tile (300ms ease-out, collapsed under prefers-reduced-motion, as is every transition). Everything else stays a color shift; all other interactive transitions are transition-colors at ~150ms; the primary button dims to 90% ember, the outline button fills to Ash Surface with an Ember border, links underline. The mobile buy bar enters by opacity fade only (200ms).

dos: Do source every color from the token layer — :root custom properties consumed via the Tailwind theme mapping (bg-primary, text-accent, border-input, ring-ring, bg-surface) or the primitives in components/ui/.
Do keep every deployment-specific value (name, logo via siteLogo, hero copy, philosophy band, buy links, theme stylesheet) in config/config.json or the studio table — never inside a component.

Do give every interactive element a visible 2px Ember focus ring (focus-visible), and let the global CSS carry the browser chrome: color-scheme: dark, ember selection and caret, thin token scrollbars.
Do frame catalog media in a portrait 3:4 inset tile with object-cover object-center — the image fills the tile edge to edge, no empty bars; the baked background color shows only while it loads.
Do mirror the token block as literal values inside any satori renderer (they cannot read CSS variables) and re-sync those literals whenever the tokens change.
Do treat Poppins, Inter, and this palette as swappable defaults: build against roles (primary, muted, surface), not against specific values.
donts: Don't write a literal hex, rgb, or palette-utility color into a component — the token definition file, the form-status pair, the blur-shimmer/themeColor chrome values, and satori renderers' token mirrors are the only sanctioned exceptions.
Don't introduce hues outside the token set; Ember is the only interactive hue, and green/red pairs are reserved for form success/error semantics only.
Don't animate hover with elevation, shadow, or decorative transforms — color shifts, fills, underlines, and the single sanctioned design-card image zoom only.
Don't put Poppins into body copy, controls, or labels — the display voice sings only in headings and card titles.
Don't sprinkle eyebrows onto ordinary content or stack white surfaces on the graphite field — panels are Panel-colored, one step up, behind a hairline.
Don't bake any single deployment's brand (name, monogram text, shop, imagery, hero copy) into a component — the product is white-label and every brand touchpoint is configuration.
